title: test(plugin-approvals): pay the translations load at module top so the action-page suite's first case stops timing out
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DFWmDYdUPFhME7Z7Ky3ySCZ)_

Fixes #33508

Area-lease pilot #33059, area A3.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改一个测试文件，加一行模块顶部 `import './translations/index.js';` 和注释。不改任何产品代码。
- 为什么改：该文件第一个用例启动真实内核时，审批插件在 `kernel:ready` 里懒加载翻译模块，翻译模块再冷加载 `@objectstack/platform-objects/apps`（`dist/`）。这次冷加载算进了第一个用例的 5 秒超时；CI 负载高时用例跑到 5.7-6.2 秒，超时，把别的区域的 PR 挤出合并队列。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险，不发布任何东西。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/action-page-member.integration.test.ts` 第 40-47 行（新增的 import 与理由）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=verbose src/action-page-member.integration.test.ts`，应见 `Tests 13 passed (13)`，且第一个用例在几百毫秒内，不再是约 1 秒。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One test file, one module-top line plus its comment:
`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/action-page-member.integration.test.ts` now loads
`./translations/index.js` at module top. No product code changes.

## Why

The case "GET renders the confirm page for a live token, and never decides however often it is
fetched" timed out at 5000 ms in Test Core (5737 ms, 5858 ms and 6165 ms in runs 43647010018,
43647280081 and 43649385454). It is the file's first case, so it pays the file's cold costs.

Measured cause, from a phase-timing probe on a 4-vCPU box (the probe file was deleted):

- In the first `bootStack()`, `kernel.bootstrap()` took 704-790 ms. In later boots it took 6-10 ms.
- Plugin `init`/`start` took 5-10 ms each. The time is in ONE `kernel:ready` handler, the plugin's
  i18n hook, at 714 ms. `ObjectKernel` injects the core in-memory `i18n` fallback, so that hook runs
  `await import('./translations/index.js')`.
- That module imports `@objectstack/platform-objects/apps`, which this package resolves through
  `dist/`. Warming only that subpath at module top cut the hook from 714 ms to 121 ms. Warming
  `./translations/index.js` cut the whole first `bootstrap()` to 7-8 ms.

On a loaded CI shard the same load took about 5 s. Vitest clocks test bodies and hooks, but not
collection. So a module-top import pays the load where no timeout applies (AGENTS.md: "clocked
windows measure behaviour, never loading").

Not the cause: PR #33430 (6e50a5d3f8). It added a later case to this file and did not touch the
first case's code or its boot path. Run 43644019695, at a base that already contains 6e50a5d3f8,
passed this case in 3628 ms. That is 73% of the budget, so the case was already near the limit
before any failure.

## Verification

<details><summary>Before and after: first-case timing, 3 runs idle and 3 under 4 CPU burners, --maxWorkers=2</summary>

Both legs ran at head `adbe316c25`. For the "before" leg, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the
import line. It confirmed the anchor went from 1 to 0, and restored the file to the HEAD blob
(`git diff HEAD` empty).

| leg | idle-1 | idle-2 | idle-3 | load-1 | load-2 | load-3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| before (import removed) | 987 ms | 1081 ms | 1229 ms | 1531 ms | 1846 ms | 1928 ms |
| after (this PR) | 342 ms | 235 ms | 281 ms | 490 ms | 345 ms | 426 ms |

All 12 runs: `Tests 13 passed (13)`. The other 12 cases are unchanged at 40-170 ms idle.
</details>

<details><summary>Package tests, typecheck, lint and derived gates, all at head adbe316c25</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (whole package, under
  os-verify-lock): `Test Files 120 passed (120)` · `Tests 1652 passed (1652)` · VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, scripts project,
  `check:test-typecheck`): VERDICT command-exit 0. The test layer compiles; the ledger is held.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed file: exit 0. `check-nul-bytes`: OK.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 53 commands for the one changed path. 51 ran
  and exited 0. `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: they need
  the workspace CLI and a full workspace build, which this box does not have. `--ran` reports `53
  derived, 51 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. Neither gate reads a test file. CI's Lint & Repo Gates runs
  both.
- Dependents: `turbo ls --affected` against origin/main lists 14 packages. That set comes from the
  package graph, so it does not see tests that read another package's source from disk. This diff changes
  a `*.test.ts` that no package imports or ships, so the dependents' inputs are byte-identical. Their tests
  are left to CI (Test Core runs the affected set).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Publishing: the only changed file is a `*.test.ts`. The package ships `dist`, and tsup does not
  bundle test files. This PR takes `skip-changeset`, applied with the create.
- Gate boundary: `check:test-source-alias` has a "source reach" reader for this pattern. It does
  not see this site because the first hop is a relative `await import('./translations/index.js')`
  inside a function. The gate header lists that as a deliberate silent boundary ("Collection-time
  edges only"). `@objectstack/platform-objects` is already in this package's measured
  `KNOWN_UNALIASED_TEST_IMPORTS`. The boundary is noted here, not filed.
- Sibling files that boot the plugin on an `ObjectKernel`
  (`plugin-shutdown-cancels-escalation-job.test.ts`,
  `save-notice-approval-round-trip.integration.test.ts`) had first cases of 325-699 ms in the same
  failed runs, well under budget. They are not changed.
